You say you want a mansion. Kevin says that is not big enough.

Kevin Trudeau plays a game. Someone names what they want, a mansion, and he keeps answering that they are not thinking big enough. Then come a lake house, a boat and owning everything outright.

Every time someone answers, he says to think bigger. His point is that most people shrink their dreams long before they ever test them.

How big would your dream be if nobody was watching?
